bugs.detail: Graph invocation crashed at checkpoint serialization: 'Type is not JSON serializable: asyncpg.pgproto.pgproto.UUID'. Root cause: CustomerResolveMiddleware O2 fix (agent/middleware/customer_resolve.py:282,296-298) writes the raw asyncpg UUID (customer.id from SQLAlchemy/asyncpg row) into LangGraph graph state via Command(update={'customer_id': customer['id']}); the Redis JsonPlusRedisSerializer cannot serialize asyncpg.pgproto.UUID. Bot returned the generic fallback message. Same crash observed on an unrelated live conversation (287b979a) at the same time — affects ALL returning-customer turns.

bugs.detail: book tool returned 'tool.response.rejected' with next_step='reoffer_slots' AFTER the customer accepted the slot the bot itself offered via get_next_available_options. This is the O1 P0 the Change O fix was supposed to eliminate — book must ACCEPT a slot it offered, not re-reject it. update_booking also returned next_step='reoffer_slots'. Booking did NOT complete; no appointment row created.

turns.user_message: Sí, reinténtalo por favor, ese mismo hueco.
turns.agent_response:
Sigo teniendo el mismo bloqueo técnico al cerrar la reserva. No quiero hacerte perder más tiempo.

Si quieres, puedo avisar al equipo para que lo revisen manualmente.

bugs.detail: Retry of book again returned reoffer_slots — deterministic, not a transient race. Booking remains blocked.

asyncpg.pgproto.pgproto.UUID is not JSON serializable by the LangGraph Redis checkpointer. CustomerResolveMiddleware O2 fix writes the raw asyncpg UUID into graph state (agent/middleware/customer_resolve.py:282,296-298). Every checkpoint write fails; state.has_checkpoint stays false, so the conversation never persists durable state. Affects all returning customers resolved by phone.

book rejects a slot the bot offered and the customer accepted (next_step=reoffer_slots). Change O1 fix is NOT effective end-to-end on this deploy (commit 7caff82). Likely related to/compounded by the checkpoint never persisting: the offered-slot token / draft state that book validates against is lost because no checkpoint is written between turns.
